<script>
var prevLink = null;
function handleClick(e) {
	if ( e.target && e.target.hasAttribute('aria-expanded') ) {
		e.preventDefault();
		var link = e.target;
		if ( prevLink !== null ) {
			prevLink.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
			document.getElementById(prevLink.getAttribute('aria-controls')).classList.remove('show');
			if ( prevLink === link ) {
				prevLink = null;
				return;
			}
		}
		link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
		document.getElementById(link.getAttribute('aria-controls')).classList.add('show');
		prevLink = link;
		if ( link.scrollIntoView ) {
			link.scrollIntoView({
				behavior: 'smooth',
				block: 'start'
			});
		}
		return false;
	}
}
document.addEventListener('click', handleClick);

</script>
